title: Atlas database user names, placeholders and masked password displays
summary: A database user response that holds a username and a database name and no password, and a password property that holds a placeholder, an environment reference or a masked display.
rationale: The username and the database name are identifiers, and a response does not carry the password. A placeholder, reference or masked display under the password name carries no value. Flagging them would redact identifiers and templates a reader needs. The case says nothing about a percent-encoded password or a connection string.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Not flagged under project policy: these inputs hold no password value. That a username and a database name are identifiers and that a placeholder, reference or masked display is not a value are the project's decisions, not Atlas statements; Atlas documents that the password does not appear in responses.

sources.supports: CloudDatabaseUser.password: 'Alphanumeric string that authenticates this database user against the database specified in databaseName ... This parameter doesn't appear in this response.' minLength 8, writeOnly

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy.
